text:
ashley: Quick follow-up UX thread about the playground invoke helper and run history interactions. Found a few accessibility and microcopy issues when the function schema is large.
jamal: hit the same. narrow view is the worst.
ashley: Problem list:
- helper overlays run history on small widths, no focus trap or aria announcement
- header labeled 'Args' (ambiguous)
- copy button copies compact JSON with no format option
- 'beta' badge contrast fails
- long descriptions render as one line, causing layout issues
- internal keys (e.g. _meta) clutter the preview
- run history 'Open in helper' CTA is tiny

elaine: Suggested fixes: rename to 'Function inputs (schema)', add aria-live announcement, show a micro-preview inline in history (3 top keys), clamp descriptions with 'Show more', and add 'show hidden fields' toggle.

sara: Also add toasts for copy actions and keyboard shortcuts (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+C for pretty copy).
mike: Micro-preview pseudo-code:

```
preview = Object.entries(obj)
  .filter(([k]) => !k.startsWith('_'))
  .slice(0,3)
  .map(([k,v]) => `${k}: ${shortenForPreview(v)}`)
  .join(' \u00b7 ')

function shortenForPreview(v){
  const s = String(v)
  if(s.length <= 24) return s
  const truncated = s.slice(0,21)
  // prefer cut at last space to avoid mid-word breaks
  const lastSpace = truncated.lastIndexOf(' ')
  return lastSpace > 8 ? truncated.slice(0,lastSpace) + '...' : truncated + '...'
}
```

jamal: Important: ensure the micro-preview is keyboard focusable and clicking on any key opens the helper at that field.
elaine: Accessibility: announce counts when toggling hidden fields: 'Showing 3 of 7 fields'. Ensure aria-pressed on the toggle and aria-expanded on the description expander.
ashley: I'll prototype the micro-preview + header copy + pretty/compact copy CTA and attach a screenshot before the 2pm UX sync. ux-bot: Reminder: add proto to the card: https://redwood.example/kanban/ux/proto
ashley: Thanks all :thumbsup:
